name: Cerulean
desc: Cerulean is a Celtor NPC. They are the trainer for Oathless.
additional_info:
-   Cerulean wears the Verdant Sniper Outfit.
-   Their aspect variant is Marten.
-   Cerulean is named after a city in the Kanto region from the _Pokémon_ franchise. Namely, _Cerulean City_.
    -   This follows the same pattern with their Oathless disciples: [Saffron](entity:saffron), [Celadon](entity:celadon), and [Viridian](entity:viridian).
-   Cerulean usually means the shade of the color blue.
